data.narrative:
Blackstar is a Seed-stage AI & Software company founded by Daniel Edrisian, former OpenAI Codex engineer and founder of Alex (YC W24), which was acqui-hired by OpenAI in September 2025. The company has raised $12M to date. The relevant comp universe includes 16 peers in AI & Software, with 1 public comparable (Palantir) and 8 private peers including Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI, though none provide sufficient overlap in stage and valuation tier for reliable peer-median analysis.

Given the limited narrow peer set, valuation relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $12M raised proxy, reflecting typical step-up dynamics from Seed to the next financing stage. This approach yields an implied valuation of $30M.

The triangulated valuation range is $26M to $34M, with a median of $30M. This analysis is supported by a single applicable method; the peer-median approach was not viable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting quality thresholds. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer benchmarks at this stage and the reliance on a standard multiplier that may not fully capture founder track record (successful prior exit to OpenAI) or market momentum in AI tooling. Validation through additional data on recent Seed-stage AI financing outcomes would strengthen confidence in this range.
